name: red-first
title: The scenario, then the failing run
kicker: How it was built · Red first, live
html:
The scenario, then the failing run

Scenario: A step that only reads is kept in the
  script when a later step names what it read
  `as NAME` on a read is no detour when a later step
  names it: the watch is asked about ${front.@self}
  Given the file "named-read.goal.md" is
    - Search the desk's releases that are {state}
      `as front`
    - At {watcher}, ask to be told when {front}
      offers desk:release `as watch`
  …
  Then the script has a line with
    "- act: desk:search-releases"

the whole scenario

# the red run, logged by the gate
496 tests completed, 1 failed,
41 skipped
testcase: A step that only reads
is kept in the script when …

Red on behaviour, not on a compile error. The gate logs the run; only then may src/main change.
say: A real one from this work. The real-GitHub capture dropped the step that opens the pull request, because nothing read a value from it; a later step only named it. The scenario says so first, and the run fails on behaviour before any code is written.
